method: Frames viewed by the author (Claude) as plain images with only the zone outline drawn (no detector boxes), people counted whose feet are inside the outline. People whose feet sit within ~10 px of the outline count 0.5. 'range' = plausible low/high count. Counted BEFORE looking at the detector boxes, except people_detection (3 clear people, seen earlier in an annotated preview).
